mechanism: Progestin (P4 or MPA) binds and activates the epithelial progesterone receptor.
model_assumption: E_PGR is receptor activity, not PGR expression; E2 induction of PGR expression is not represented.

mechanism: PGR-dependent epithelial Indian hedgehog expression.
model_assumption: Inherited from the prototype. Graded per-edge support is weak; evidence is topic-level and largely mouse.

mechanism: Progestin activates the stromal progesterone receptor.
model_assumption: Separate from E_PGR so that compartment-specific receptor perturbations remain expressible.

mechanism: 8-Br-cAMP activates stromal PKA signalling.
model_assumption: Epithelial cAMP effects are not represented.

mechanism: Epithelial IHH acts on stromal Hedgehog reception and induces COUP-TFII (NR2F2).
model_assumption: Hedgehog reception (PTCH1/SMO/GLI) is lumped into this edge: a separate reception node was refused in the prototype because it would be an exact alias (TI017).

mechanism: Stromal PGR is required for the NR2F2 response.
model_assumption: Conjunctive (AND) with IHH reception.

mechanism: Hormone-treated ADOC stroma expresses BMP2 (scRNA-seq).
model_assumption: Expression program evidence; does not prove the rule.

mechanism: cAMP arm of the BMP2 induction gate.
model_assumption: Executed without curated provenance in v0.6.0 (PAR-004) and absorbed (structure.json): pinning S_PKA never changes S_BMP2 because S_NR2F2 carries the same progesterone signal. Retained so that the inherited rule is unchanged; flagged for WP1 curation.

mechanism: COUP-TFII controls stromal BMP2 (mouse, with BMP2 add-back rescue).
model_assumption: Mouse evidence.

mechanism: BMP2 ligand signals through type I/II BMP receptors to phosphorylate SMAD1/5/8; pSMAD1/5 is measured in human ESC during decidualization.
model_assumption: Separates ligand expression from pathway activity. Receptor availability and antagonists are not represented.

mechanism: A BMP type I receptor inhibitor blocks SMAD1/5/8 phosphorylation.
model_assumption: Target engagement must be confirmed experimentally (pSMAD1/5/8, Task 1.4). Effects on the epithelium are not represented.

mechanism: Inherited S_BMP2 -> S_HAND2 dependency, rerouted through the receptor step because a ligand can act only through its receptor.
model_assumption: Redundant in the unperturbed network (S_BMP_SMAD implies S_PGR, so HAND2 equals S_PGR in every reachable state); not absorbed by the prototype definition, because constitutive SMAD activity would change HAND2. Weakly supported; recorded, not hidden.

mechanism: Progesterone induces stromal HAND2 (absent in PR-null mouse uterus; induced in human decidualization).
model_assumption: HAND2 is maintained by PGR independently of BMP signalling in every reachable state.

mechanism: HAND2 represses stromal mitogenic ligand expression (Fgf1/2/9/18 in mouse; FGF9 only in human ESC).
model_assumption: The node is a mechanism, not a ligand: identity of the human epithelial mitogen is unresolved.

mechanism: Stromal paracrine signal supports E2-driven epithelial proliferation.
model_assumption: Causal step inferred in mouse (no add-back or receptor blockade). Default Q2 hypothesis (stromal relay).

mechanism: Oestradiol drives epithelial proliferation.
model_assumption: Executed without curated provenance in v0.6.0 (PAR-003). E2 is necessary in every Q2 variant.

mechanism: Secretory differentiation is induced under E2 priming followed by the progestin-containing step.
model_assumption: ADOC regimen supplies E2 throughout; E2-free differentiation is not represented.

mechanism: Epithelial secretory program (PAEP) rises after the progestin-containing step.
model_assumption: In the supplemented regimen MPA, cAMP and XAV939 are applied together, so the response cannot be attributed to the progestin alone (OQ-01, OQ-04).

mechanism: Progesterone receptor signalling is required for stromal decidualization.
model_assumption: PGR activity is required in every Q1 variant.

mechanism: cAMP/PKA signalling gates IGFBP1 and PRL induction in human ESC.
model_assumption: Predicts no decidualization under progestin alone (hormone-only regimen); a testable consequence of Task 1.1.

mechanism: SMAD1/5 knockdown impairs human decidualization (IGFBP1, WNT4) and BMP2 rescues (Liao 2024); Bmp2 is required in mouse.
model_assumption: Default Q1 hypothesis H1-BMP-required. The alternative H1-PGR-sufficient removes this dependency (rule_variants.tsv).

mechanism: IL-1beta engages IL-1 receptor signalling in stromal cells.
model_assumption: Generic receptor-signalling node: ERK1/2 (Yu 2019), JNK (Taylor 2024) and NF-kappaB routes are not distinguished. Epithelial IL-1 responses are not represented.

mechanism: IL-1beta impairs human stromal decidualization (PRL and IGFBP-1 reduced) in four independent studies.
model_assumption: Encoded as a direct, route-agnostic inhibition. Present in every Q1 variant. Provisional until G2 data (WP3/Task 4.1).

mechanism: Direct HAND2 term of the legacy v0.5.1 representation (variant Q2_relay_plus_direct_v051).
model_assumption: No paper supports a direct epithelial HAND2 edge; retained only to reproduce the v0.5.1 vs v0.5.2 transient comparison.

mechanism: Epithelial PGR suppresses E2-driven proliferation without stromal mediation (variant Q2_epithelial_autonomous).
model_assumption: Alternative required by the grant question Q2; no corpus paper supports it as the primary route.

mechanism: IL-1beta depletes stromal PR (variant INF_pgr_depletion).
model_assumption: PR depletion is reported in human ESC (abstract-level reading); Boolean loss of S_PGR is a strong simplification of partial depletion.
